cards.title: Performance of quantum error correction with coherent errors
cards.authors: E. Huang, A. Doherty, S. Flammia
cards.tldr: We compare the performance of quantum error correcting codes when memory errors are unitary with the more familiar case of dephasing noise.

cards.title: Recent Advances in Quantum Error Correction Codes for Superconducting Quantum Computing
cards.authors: Zihang Wang, G. Gao, Guangming Wu
cards.venue: 2026 6th International Symposium on Computer Technology and Information Science (ISCTIS)
cards.tldr: Superconducting quantum computing has become one of the leading technological routes toward practical quantum computing due to its relatively long coherence times and compatibility with scalable integration.

cards.title: Fundamental Thresholds for Computational and Erasure Errors via the Coherent Information
cards.authors: Luis Colmenarez, Seyong Kim, M. Müller
cards.tldr: In this work, we propose a framework based on the coherent information (CI) of the mixed-state density operator associated to noisy QEC codes, for treating both types of errors together.

cards.title: Characterizing Quantum Error Correction Performance of Radiation-induced Errors
cards.authors: Paul Baity, A. K. Nayak, L. Varshney et al.
cards.tldr: Radiation impacts are a current challenge with computing on superconducting-based quantum devices because they can lead to widespread correlated errors across the device.

cards.title: FPGA-Accelerated Early-Exit Neural Decoder for Quantum Error Correction
cards.venue: Euromicro Symposium on Digital Systems Design
cards.tldr: In this work, we present QUNET, a quantized modular UNet decoder for surface codes, which incorporates quantization-aware training (QAT) to compress weights and activations to as low as 4 bits and introduces an early-exit mechanism that dynamically routes.

cards.title: Scalable Quantum Error Correction for Surface Codes Using FPGA
cards.authors: Namitha Liyanage, Yue Wu, Alexander Dennisovich Deters et al.
cards.venue: International Conference on Quantum Computing and Engineering
cards.tldr: A fault-tolerant quantum computer must decode and correct errors faster than they appear. The faster errors can be corrected, the more time the computer can do useful work.

cards.title: Building logical qubits in a superconducting quantum computing system
cards.authors: J. Gambetta, J. Chow, M. Steffen
cards.tldr: The technological world is in the midst of a quantum computing and quantum information revolution. Here, we describe the important route towards a logical memory with superconducting qubits, employing a rotated version of the surface code.

cards.title: Constructing Quantum Surface Codes for Arbitrary Surface Forms
cards.authors: Melinda Br Ginting, Khoirul Anwar, Dick Maryopi
cards.venue: 2021 IEEE Symposium On Future Telecommunication Technologies (SOFTT)
cards.tldr: Quantum technology has been considered as one of the key enablers for the sixth-generation (6G) wireless commu-nication systems. We investigate the matrix generated from Roffe $[[5,1,2]]$ quantum surface codes and compare to that of the proposed $[[5,1,2]]$ quantum surface codes.

cards.title: Universal control and error correction in multi-qubit spin registers in diamond.
cards.authors: T. Taminiau, J. Cramer, T. van der Sar et al.
cards.tldr: Quantum registers of nuclear spins coupled to electron spins of individual solid-state defects are a promising platform for quantum information processing.
cards.ref_status_tooltip: Over 423 papers build directly on this landmark work. Full reference list is available inside the paper PDF.

cards.title: Assessing Finite Scalability in Early Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computing for Homogeneous Catalysts
cards.authors: Yanbing Zhou, Athena Caesura, C. Buda et al.
cards.tldr: As quantum hardware advances toward fault-tolerant operation, an intermediate stage known as early fault-tolerant quantum computing (EFTQC) is emerging, where partial error correction enables meaningful computation.
